classified_observations: Praxis operator restarted once at startup after logging LeadershipLost; recovered before feature tests. This is a product leader-election event, not host pressure or an API outage.

Three observed data-plane exit-137 terminations occurred on pods already marked for deletion; restartCount was zero, reason was Error rather than OOMKilled, and no node pressure was observed. Retained as rollout/cleanup observations.

Warning events include historical boot events and transient readiness, mount and endpoint conflicts during pod/resource creation and deletion; none prevented fixture readiness or caused a recorded infrastructure failure.
Unready Gateways during TLSRoute and ListenerSet tests were rejected or left unimplemented by the product, while nodes and echo fixtures remained available. These are selected feature-test failures.

Agentgateway static-address failure reproduced in an excluded passive watch diagnostic: resourceVersion 42803 had latest-generation Programmed=True and no status.addresses. Its deletion event retained that state. The static IP allocator was independently qualified. This is retained as a product status-ordering finding, not removed as an infrastructure or stale-snapshot artifact.
exclusions: Initial agentgateway attempt under the old TCP client profile and focused diagnostics are excluded; see evidence/exclusions.json.
decision: Proceed with repetitions two and three using the unchanged measured profile, pinned products and upstream test binary.
